name: Voxelization & Volume
description: Convert meshes and point clouds to voxel grids. Perform volumetric operations like binary erosion and marching cubes reconstruction.

theory.overview:
Voxelization discretizes a 3D space into a regular grid of cubic cells (voxels). Each voxel stores a scalar value (occupancy, SDF, density). The inverse process extracts a surface mesh from this volumetric representation.

Marching Cubes is the standard iso-surface extraction algorithm. For each cube in the voxel grid, it classifies vertices as inside or outside the iso-surface based on their scalar values relative to an iso-value $\tau$.

Binary erosion shrinks a solid by removing boundary voxels using a structuring element.

voxelization.title: Mesh Voxelization
voxelization.content: Voxelization converts a triangle mesh into a 3D occupancy grid. Open3D creates a VoxelGrid by testing which voxels intersect the mesh surface. The voxel size $v$ controls the resolution of the grid.

binary_erosion.title: Binary Erosion + Reconstruction
binary_erosion.content:
Binary erosion shrinks a solid by removing boundary voxels. For a volume $V$ and structuring element $B$:
$$V \ominus B = \{x : B_x \subseteq V\}$$
The eroded volume is then reconstructed back to a mesh using marching cubes at iso-value 0.5.

parameters.name: voxel_size
parameters.description: Size of each voxel cube. Smaller = more detail.

parameters.name: voxel_size
parameters.description: Voxel size for the occupancy grid.

parameters.name: padding_voxels
parameters.description: Padding added around the bounding box, expressed in voxels.
